title: Zero Optimization
description: This is a lightweight optimization modpack.
body:
## Zero Optimization
The ultimate performance-focused experience for Minecraft.
> Do you love Minecraft but hate the lag? Zero Optimization is designed to squeeze every frame out of your hardware, providing a silky-smooth gameplay experience without compromising the "vanilla feel" of the game.

## 🚀 Why should you choose Zero Optimization
- Massive FPS Boost: Optimized rendering and engine tweaks to ensure high frame rates, even on older hardware.
- Reduced Stutter: Say goodbye to micro-stutters caused by aggressive garbage collection and chunk loading.
- Faster Load Times: Optimized asset loading so you can jump into your world in seconds.
- Vanilla+ Experience: We’ve kept the core gameplay exactly as Mojang intended—no game-breaking changes, just better performance.
- Battery Saver: Perfect for laptops and handheld devices by reducing unnecessary CPU overhead.
